ingredients.name: Taco seasoning
ingredients.note: or homemade: 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, ½ tsp garlic powder

ingredients.name: Cheddar cheese
ingredients.note: or Monterey Jack or queso fresco

steps.b: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. No oil needed — the beef fat will render.
Add {gb:ground beef}, breaking it into small crumbles with a wooden spoon.
Season with {ts:taco seasoning} and ½ tsp {sa:salt}. Stir to coat evenly.
Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until beef is browned and no pink remains.
Warm {ct:corn tortillas} in a dry skillet over medium heat, 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beef, {ch:cheddar cheese}, {sl:salsa}, {sc:sour cream}, avocado slices, a squeeze of lime and cilantro.
